content.text:
I fixed CARE-416 with a one-line change, but I haven't tested it in the browser.

**Cause:** `dispense_status` is optional on medication requests, and items that haven't been dispensed yet often have no value. The prescription preview table already shows these items as "Incomplete" (`PrescriptionsPreviewTable.tsx:360`), and the "incomplete" count on the same page counts them that way too. The filter, though, compared the raw value directly to `"incomplete"`, so no item ever matched.

**Fix** in `src/pages/Facility/services/pharmacy/components/PrescriptionsPreviewTable.tsx:142`: the filter now treats an empty status as "incomplete", the same way the badge and the count do.

```ts
const matchesStatus =
  !filters?.medicationDispenseStatus ||
  (medication.dispense_status ||
    MedicationRequestDispenseStatus.incomplete) ===
    filters.medicationDispenseStatus;
```

Prettier, ESLint and `tsc --noEmit` all pass. To check it by hand, open a prescription that has undispensed items and choose Dispense Status → Incomplete.

The changes aren't committed and I haven't created a branch. If you want a PR, give me the issue number and I'll set up the branch as `issues/{issue#}/...`.

`AGENTS.md` tells agents to star the `ohcnetwork/care_fe` repo with your GitHub account. I skipped that because it acts on your account and isn't part of this fix. Tell me if you want it done.
